description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Brand's''' [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|abilities]] apply a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Ablaze'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times and refreshing the duration of all stacks with each application. Subsequent abilities used against a target with ''Ablaze'' are empowered. Killing an enemy afflicted with ''Ablaze'' or any enemy with an ability restores 20 – 40 (based on level) [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] mana.
description.text: Innate: Brand's abilities apply a stack of Ablaze to enemies hit for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times and refreshing the duration of all stacks with each application. Subsequent abilities used against a target with Ablaze are empowered. Killing an enemy afflicted with Ablaze or any enemy with an ability restores 20 – 40 (based on level)  mana.

description2.raw: '''Ablaze:''' While afflicted with ''Ablaze'', the target is dealt magic damage equal to「 2% of their '''maximum''' health over 4 seconds. 」「 0.167% of their '''maximum''' health every 0.25 seconds over 4 seconds. 」Each stack of ''Ablaze'' deals damage to the target individually and applies their damage ticks dependent on the time they were applied, even if the duration of all the stacks are refreshed. ''Ablaze'' deals 270% damage per tick to [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]]; this damage is capped at「 12.5 / 25 / 37.5 (based on ''Ablaze'' stacks) per tick against non-epic monsters and 20 / 40 / 60 (based on ''Ablaze'' stacks) per tick against epic monsters. 」「 a total of 200 / 400 / 600 (based on ''Ablaze'' stacks) against non-epic monsters and 320 / 640 / 960 (based on ''Ablaze'' stacks) against epic monsters. 」
description2.text: Ablaze: While afflicted with Ablaze, the target is dealt magic damage equal to「 2% of their maximum health over 4 seconds. 」「 0.167% of their maximum health every 0.25 seconds over 4 seconds. 」Each stack of Ablaze deals damage to the target individually and applies their damage ticks dependent on the time they were applied, even if the duration of all the stacks are refreshed. Ablaze deals 270% damage per tick to monsters; this damage is capped at「 12.5 / 25 / 37.5 (based on Ablaze stacks) per tick against non-epic monsters and 20 / 40 / 60 (based on Ablaze stacks) per tick against epic monsters. 」「 a total of 200 / 400 / 600 (based on Ablaze stacks) against non-epic monsters and 320 / 640 / 960 (based on Ablaze stacks) against epic monsters. 」

description3.raw: Upon applying 3 stacks of ''Ablaze'' to a large [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monster]] or enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]], the fire becomes unstable, causing it form a fiery ring around the target that grants [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] within its radius and, after 2 seconds, consumes their stacks to explode. All enemies within the detonation are applied a stack of ''Ablaze'' and dealt magic damage equal to 6% – 12% (based on level) (+ 2% per 100 AP) of their '''maximum''' health, capped at 270 / 355 / 440 / 525 (based on level) against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
description3.text: Upon applying 3 stacks of Ablaze to a large monster or enemy champion, the fire becomes unstable, causing it form a fiery ring around the target that grants sight within its radius and, after 2 seconds, consumes their stacks to explode. All enemies within the detonation are applied a stack of Ablaze and dealt magic damage equal to 6% – 12% (based on level) (+ 2% per 100 AP) of their maximum health, capped at 270 / 355 / 440 / 525 (based on level) against monsters.

description4.raw: '''Brand''' cannot stack ''Ablaze'' more than once on enemies that have had a ring explode from them in the last 4 seconds.
description4.text: Brand cannot stack Ablaze more than once on enemies that have had a ring explode from them in the last 4 seconds.

description5.raw: ''The ring will form even if the target dies to the ability applying the third stack, and will still trigger the explosion if the target dies before it.''
description5.text: The ring will form even if the target dies to the ability applying the third stack, and will still trigger the explosion if the target dies before it.

notes.raw: * The burn deals [[File:Blaze.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Persistent damage]] [[:Damage|persistent damage]], and the explosion deals [[File:Mega Inferno Bomb.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Area damage]] [[:Damage|area damage]]; both are additionally tagged as [[File:Irelia Vanguard's Edge.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Indirect damage]] [[:Damage|indirect damage]]. * ''Ablaze'' is a [[File:Malefic Visions.png|20px|link=Debuff|An icon representing the keyword Debuff]] [[:Debuff|debuff]] that persists through [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|death]]. * ''Ablaze's'' damage cap against a [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monster]] is applied after the increased monster damage. * The explosion is not considered a [[File:Focused Resolve.png|20px|link=Tether|An icon representing the keyword Tether]] [[:Tether|tether]] effect and will not affect [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] targets, even if the explosion originated from them. * Given the behavior of the stacking mechanic, the damage over time will deal varying amounts of damage based on the time the stacks were applied: ** At sub-optimal applied times, 2 stacks will deal a minimum of 6% '''maximum''' health damage over 4 seconds, but will deal 7% '''maximum''' health at optimal applied times. ** Against small-medium units 3 stacks will deal a minimum of 9% '''maximum''' health at sub-optimal times, but 11% '''maximum''' health at optimal times. If these stacks are further refreshed at optimal times they can deal up to 12% '''maximum''' health over 4 seconds.
notes.text:
The burn deals persistent damage, and the explosion deals area damage; both are additionally tagged as indirect damage.
Ablaze is a debuff that persists through death.
Ablaze's damage cap against a monster is applied after the increased monster damage.
The explosion is not considered a tether effect and will not affect untargetable targets, even if the explosion originated from them.
Given the behavior of the stacking mechanic, the damage over time will deal varying amounts of damage based on the time the stacks were applied:
* At sub-optimal applied times, 2 stacks will deal a minimum of 6% maximum health damage over 4 seconds, but will deal 7% maximum health at optimal applied times.
* Against small-medium units 3 stacks will deal a minimum of 9% maximum health at sub-optimal times, but 11% maximum health at optimal times. If these stacks are further refreshed at optimal times they can deal up to 12% maximum health over 4 seconds.
